## File: settings-registry-menu.yaml
## Type: project menu
## Purpose: Menu to configure settings registry paths, semantic rules,
## and key synonyms for the application.

metadata:
  udi: prismata.universe.menu.settings.registry
  name: "Settings > Registry Menu"
  version: "0.1.0"
  kind: menu
  description: "Submenu for registry path and semantic rules."

items:
  - key: "1"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.settings.registry.path"
    label: "Set Registry Path"
    description: "Set the registry file/folder path used by Universe operations."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-registry"
    setting_key: "registry_path"
    value_type: "string"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "2"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.settings.registry.rules"
    label: "Set Semantic Rules (JSON)"
    description: "Set semantic rules using a JSON object payload."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-registry"
    setting_key: "semantic_rules"
    value_type: "object_json"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "3"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.settings.registry.synonyms"
    label: "Set Key Synonyms (JSON)"
    description: "Set key synonyms using a JSON object payload."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-registry"
    setting_key: "key_synonyms"
    value_type: "object_json"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null
